# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft Office Shared Computer Activation

Lets Microsoft 365 Apps on shared devices activate per signed-in user instead of once per device, so that everyone uses Office with their own licence and the device does not count towards one user's installation limit.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own baseline — Office ADMX, Microsoft Office 2016 (Machine) > Licensing Settings > Use shared computer activation (L_SharedComputerLicensing = 1). Microsoft requires this for Microsoft 365 Apps on devices that several people use. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Microsoft_Office_Shared_Computer_Activation.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Microsoft_Office_Shared_Computer_Activation.json) |

> Belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared, next to [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared PC or [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared PC Domain and Guest. The licensing token is stored in the user profile and goes when Shared PC cleans up the profile; at the next sign-in Office fetches a new token, so opening Office for the first time needs an internet connection. Every user needs a licence that supports shared computer activation. A Shared PC guest has no Entra account and therefore no Office licence. If Office on the device is already activated per device, that activation stays: preferably start with a clean device (Autopilot reset), as with Shared PC.
